name: Tobira
summary: Turns your website into a site agent that answers people and other AI agents, then books, sells or starts a trial.
description: Tobira publishes a site agent from your pages and documents so it can answer visitors and incoming AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others) with structured facts, book meetings, take payment or send a trial link, and hand hard cases to your team. Leads can be sent to WhatsApp, Telegram, email or a CRM. A public Tobira network address is optional. Free plan uses your own OpenAI or OpenRouter key (up to 1,000 conversations/month).

pricing.details: Free (your own key, up to 1,000 conversations/month); Lite 44 €/month, Start 151 €/month, Business 356 €/month, Premium 714 €/month.
